The text shown before this instruction is about two separate topics:

1. The Lego Movie and related media, focusing on Superman (Channing Tatum/Nolan North) as a Master Builder and his role in the story.

- Superman is a DC Comics superhero and Master Builder who is annoyed by Green Lantern and attends the meeting in Cloud Cuckoo Land.
- During the attack on Cloud Cuckoo Land, Superman takes down one of the Super Secret Police's vehicles but is immobilized by a wad of gum and captured.
- In The Lego Batman Movie, Superman and Batman have a hostile relationship.

2. An aircraft incident with cabin pressure issues and altitude changes.

- The aircraft's cabin pressure drops from 14.09 to 11.64 psi (97.1 to 80.3 kPa) at an altitude greater than 10,000 feet (3,048 m), activating a "cabin altitude >10,000 feet warning."
- The aircraft reaches a maximum altitude of 16,320 feet (4,974 m) and begins to descend.
- The autopilot selected altitude changes from 23,000 to 10,000 feet (7,010 to 3,048 m).
- The Master caution activates and deactivates twice during the incident.
- The aircraft begins a left turn, heading north back to PDX, descends below 10,000 feet (3,048 m), and the "cabin altitude >10,000 feet warning" deactivates while passing 9,050 feet (2,758 m). The cabin pressure is recorded at 10 psi (69 kPa) at this point.

Superman Clark Kent / Superman (voiced by Channing Tatum in The Lego Movie, The Lego Batman Movie and The Lego Movie 2: The Second Part, Nolan North in Lego Dimensions) is a DC Comics superhero, member of the Justice League, and Master Builder. In The Lego Movie, Superman is shown to be annoyed by Green Lantern and was among the Master Builders that attend the meeting in Cloud Cuckoo Land. During the attack on Cloud Cuckoo Land, Superman took down one of the Super Secret Police's vehicles before being immobilized by a wad of gum leading to his capture. In The Lego Batman Movie, he and Batman are shown to have a hostile relationship similar to how they started out in Batman v Superman: Dawn of Justice during one confrontation
